data.title: Ethereum ETFs Outpace Bitcoin ETFs in 2026 Inflows
data.description: Ethereum ETFs pulled in more new money than Bitcoin ETFs so far in 2026, yet Bitcoin funds remain six times larger. Understanding why reveals a surprising gap that could take decades to close.
